title: Mr Best’s
html_source:
Ellmann, p118 writes about Best ‘he spoke with a prissiness that Joyce mocked in Ulysses’.

The sixteen mentions of Mr. Best in Scylla and Charybdis include the following verbs or modifiers

tall, young, mild, light
forward, amiable
unoffending
brightly, gladly
piped
pleaded
said youngly
gan murmur
turned to him
said
said
said gently
eagerquietly
douce herald
asked

Mr Best’s occurs three times with

appealed
quiet, forgetfully
approval

He and his utterances are lightweight is jj’s message.
